verdict: Revenue rose 8% to $2.17B and GAAP profit jumped 22% to $485M, helped by a $56M gain on its Indicor stake, while the core software businesses grew 7% on their own.

kpis.note: Spent on three small bolt-on deals in the quarter

flow.otherDetail: Other income of -$51M is mainly net interest expense of about $107M, partly offset by a $56M gain on Roper's minority stake in Indicor.

follow100Note: Whole-$M rounding: SG&A is shown as $900M (reported $899M) so the rounded figures balance exactly.

takeaways.title: Steady growth across the portfolio
takeaways.text: Revenue reached $2.17B with 7% organic growth (growth from the existing businesses, not deals). Technology Enabled Products grew fastest at about +10%.

takeaways.title: Profit boosted by an investment gain
takeaways.text: GAAP net earnings rose to $485M, lifted by a $56M paper gain on the Indicor stake. Stripping out deal and investment effects, adjusted profit rose a more modest 5% to $586M.

takeaways.title: Full-year guidance raised
takeaways.text: Roper lifted its 2026 adjusted EPS forecast to $22.35–$22.40 and says it has more than $6B of capacity to spend on acquisitions.

oneTimers: A $56M pre-tax gain from revaluing the Indicor minority stake sits in GAAP profit; in the first nine months Roper also received $1.24B of cash proceeds from Indicor's sale of its instrumentation businesses.
